basic_details.job_title: IISER Mohali Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IISER Mohali has invited applications for one Project Technical Support-III position in the laboratory of Dr. Amar Deep, under an ICMR-funded project on bacterial toxin–antitoxin systems. The pay is ₹28,000 per month + HRA, as admissible. The appointment is initially for one year. Candidates need a three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject/field plus three years' post-qualification experience, or a postgraduate degree in a relevant subject/field. Applications go by email, with a single PDF, and must be received by 5:00 PM on 5 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF containing an updated CV and a one-page statement of research interests.
Send the PDF by email to Dr. Amar Deep. The email address is hidden on the notice page, so take it from the official notification.
Include "PTS-ICMR-2026" in the email subject line.
Make sure the application is received by 5:00 PM on 5 December 2026.
important_instructions: Send one single PDF only, with the CV and the one-page statement of research interests together. The email subject line should include "PTS-ICMR-2026". Applications must be received, not just sent, by 5:00 PM on 5 December 2026. The age limit of 35 years is counted as on the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: About the Position
content_sections.text: The notice is issued under Dean R&D, IISER Mohali, in its Project Positions listing for Project Assistant / Research Associate positions. The position sits in the laboratory of Dr. Amar Deep and is funded by ICMR. The selected candidate will work on understanding the structural and molecular basis of interactions in bacterial toxin–antitoxin systems.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the minimum essential qualifications as per ICMR guidelines dated 18.10.2024: Candidates should have a working knowledge of molecular biology, recombinant protein expression and purification, and basic microbiology techniques. Candidates with prior hands-on experience in these areas will be preferred. The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation is as per ICMR guidelines; the notice does not list the relaxation by category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject/field + three years' post-qualification experience, OR a postgraduate degree in a relevant subject/field. For Engineering/IT/CS: four-year graduate degree.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is ₹28,000 per month + HRA, as admissible. The appointment will initially be for one year. It may be extended based on satisfactory performance, as per ICMR guidelines on the tenure of project staff, but not beyond the duration of the project.

content_sections.heading: IISER Mohali Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: One position is available under the ICMR-funded project. The selected candidate will work on understanding the structural and molecular basis of interactions in bacterial toxin–antitoxin systems. The candidate should have a working knowledge of molecular biology, recombinant protein expression and purification, and basic microbiology techniques.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Mohali Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Prepare a single PDF containing an updated CV and a one-page statement of research interests. Send the PDF by email to Dr. Amar Deep. The email address is hidden on the notice page, so take it from the official notification. Include "PTS-ICMR-2026" in the email subject line. Make sure the application is received by 5:00 PM on 5 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their CV, statement of research interests, relevant experience, and fulfilment of the eligibility criteria stated in the notice. The notice does not mention an interview or written test.
